Batch Process Chl Data
## set parameters ----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# which file do you want to process? 
# set to "all" if you want to batch process
select_sampling_date <- "260914"
select_station <- "Aquahub Mooring"
instrument_folder <- "welsch"


# set your project path
project_path <- "/Users/nicoletorrie/Documents/Dalhousie/MSc/primary_productivity_project/antigonish_sampling"


files <- list.files(project_path, pattern = "chl_data", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)


# read in individual datasets and name the files
data_list <- lapply(files, read_xlsx)
names(data_list) <-  basename(files)



```

Batch process all chl data
```{r}

chl_output_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(data_list)) {
  
  # choose one file from the list to process:
  sample_df <- data_list[[i]]
  
  # set column names based on first row
  names(sample_df) <- as.character(sample_df[15, ])
  
  # add sampling date as new column
  sample_df$sample_date <- as.POSIXct(sample_df[[4, 2]])
  
  # delete the first 15 rows, remove unnecessary columns
  sample_df_clean <- sample_df[-c(1:15), -c(6:11)] %>%
    mutate(across(contains("Chla"), as.numeric))
  
  chl_output_list <- append(chl_output_list, list(sample_df_clean))
  
  all_chl_data <- bind_rows(chl_output_list)
  
}


```


```{r}
ggplot(all_chl_data, aes(x = sample_date, color = `Client ID`)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Chla Non-Acid`), size = 3) +
  labs(color = "Sampling Site", y = "Chlorophyll-a ugL-1", x = "Sampling Date") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Antigonish Chlorophyll-a Data, Welschmeyer")


```
